provider_responses.text:
Another important aspect is consistency with the rest of the CV. The title, dates, and bullet points should match the same format used for other roles. This makes the freelance experience look credible and easy to scan.

For example, use a clear title such as **Freelance AI Automation & Content Creator**, add the period, and list only relevant tasks. Focus on results-oriented responsibilities rather than vague wording, such as automating repetitive tasks, creating AI-assisted content, and helping clients improve digital workflows.

provider_responses.text:
Potential misunderstandings to avoid:

- **“AI automation” can sound vague:** State what was automated, such as customer replies, content planning, lead handling, or data organisation.
- **Avoid overstating technical work:** Only mention building systems, integrations, or coding if you actually did those tasks.
- **Clarify freelance status:** “Freelance” shows you worked independently for clients, rather than as an employee of a company.
- **Keep content creation professional:** Mention formats you created—website text, social media posts, product descriptions, marketing content—if relevant.
- **Use accurate dates:** Ensure the period matches when you started and whether the work is ongoing.
- **Do not claim measurable results unless documented:** For example, only write “increased engagement” or “saved X hours” if you can support it.
